questions.subject: HUMAN_GEOGRAPHY
questions.topic: What self-determination asserts
questions.stem: A field biologist's survey asks what self-determination primarily asserts for a people.

options.text: The right to choose their own political status.
The right to migrate freely across all borders.
The right to own all natural resources.
The right to refuse any census.

questions.explanation: Self-determination is the right of a people to choose their political status. It is not about migration or resources alone.

questions.subject: HUMAN_GEOGRAPHY

answer.exemplar: Irredentism is a state's claim to territory held by a neighbour based on ethnic or historical ties to people living there.

questions.explanation: Irredentism involves claims across borders for co-ethnics. It often fuels disputes between neighbours.
